name: pinyin-common-characters
title: Fix pinyin candidate ordering so common characters rank first
description: Typing qiu yields 丘 plus rare characters because the ICU Han-Latin reverse index is codepoint-ordered and PREFERRED_CHARACTERS lacks qiu. Add a frequency-ordered common-character table for all pinyin syllables.
creator: M0e_N00b
notes: Follow-up to the 08-23 QWERTY refactor. The ICU reverse index fallback is codepoint-ordered and surfaces rare characters; PREFERRED_CHARACTERS is incomplete.
